info.title: BUNYAH API (prototype)
info.description: BUNYAH | بُنية – Saudi-focused B2B engineering services platform. Prototype: all payments are simulated, legal and financial assumptions are pending review.

get.description: Fictional demo accounts (demo mode only) so the prototype can be tested without typing passwords.

post.description: Creates a one-time invitation link (shown once). E-mail sending is not configured in the prototype.

get.description:
scope=marketplace: published projects. scope=mine: my organization's projects, or the projects I work on
or sent proposals to (engineers).

post.description: Creates the proposal, or updates it while it is still open.

delete.description:
Archives (hides) a brief or working file uploaded by you. Nothing is destroyed. Deliverable versions,
verification documents and dispute evidence can't be removed.

get.description: Invoices and transactions for my organization (finance roles) or for me as an engineer. All DEMO.

post.description: Records a SIMULATED payment. No money moves and no card details are collected.
Runs the daily checks now. In demo mode an 'as of' date can be given to simulate time passing.

get.description: Records from the old EngConnect payment flow (kept unchanged, read-only).
